notes.summary: Values the SDK hands to the app gained required members, so a hand-built ChatContextValue, ChatQueueApi or MessageParts (a test mock or fake) no longer compiles until it has them. Nothing an app passes in changed.
notes.howTo: Add to hand-built values: ChatContextValue.submitWithResult, lastRejection, turnOutcomes and activityLog.noticeScope; ChatQueueApi.submitWithResult and lastRejection; MessageParts.turnOutcome. Provider config, SessionConfig, ChatTransport, ChatQueueStorage, ChatLocale and component props are unchanged.

notes.summary: Visible default change: the stop, safety-stop or error notice now stays on every turn that ended so, also after a reload, and a turn that ended before any answer shows it after its question.
notes.howTo: If the app draws its own per-turn notice, set activityLog: { noticeScope: 'latest' } (config.activityLog on <glirastes-chat>) or components.TurnNotice: () => null, else both show. With the queue on and no own approvalPendingHint, the approval notice now reads "Message waits until the approval is decided."; set queueApprovalWaitingHint to word it.

notes.summary: How each turn ended is recorded as a TurnOutcome per user message (useTurnOutcome, useTurnOutcomes), and submitWithResult and lastRejection say why a message was refused.
notes.howTo: Read useTurnOutcome(message) to show your own per-turn state; with a session store the outcome is saved in the user message's metadata.glirastesTurnOutcome. Use submitWithResult(text) or lastRejection to explain a refused send (session, approval-open, attachments-off, files-with-command, queue-full). See docs/chat-queue.md.

notes.summary: The pg dependency range is now >=8.11 <9, so an app with pg 8.11 or newer shares its copy. A bun lockfile from 0.19.0 or older keeps a nested glirastes/pg entry until it is removed.
notes.howTo: Only for apps that also depend on pg: to share one copy, follow the README install section (remove and re-add glirastes, or bun update pg; convert a binary bun.lockb first). pg is used only by the glirastes-runtime binary.
